requirement_text: Yükseköğretim Kurulu Başkanlığı "Yurtdışından Öğrenci Kabulüne İlişkin Esasları"da belirtilen koşulları ve Hacettepe Üniversitesi'nin belirlediği sınav veya diplomalardan kabul edilen puan şartını sağlayan adaylar en çok 3 tercih ile başvuru yapabilirler.
researcher_translation_en: Candidates who satisfy the conditions set out in the Council of Higher Education's 'Principles Governing Admission of Students from Abroad' AND the accepted score condition from the exams or diplomas determined by Hacettepe University may apply with at most 3 choices.
source_document: Hacettepe Üniversitesi Ön Lisans ve Lisans Düzeyinde Yurtdışından Öğrenci Kabul Yönergesi, MADDE 5-(1)
limitations: English gloss is THIS LANE'S TRANSLATION; the document is Turkish-only. Never evaluate against the translation. The directive does not state its own adoption date in its text (MADDE 16 says only that it takes effect on the date the Senate adopts it); MADDE 15 records that it repeals the directive adopted by Senate decision 2024-50 of 09.05.2024, so it postdates that. The filename encodes 230525 but a filename is not a published date and has not been treated as one.
researcher_notes: THIRD MODEL of the YÖK relationship, distinct from both METU and ITU: Hacettepe requires YÖK's conditions AND its own score conditions, conjunctively, in one sentence. METU delegates entirely (REQ-9101); ITU restates YÖK's categories (REQ-9111); Hacettepe layers its own on top. All three are compliant. Any ingestion that assumes one uniform Turkish pattern will misrepresent two of the three.

requirement_text: TR-YÖS: 500 puan üzerinden en az 400 puan
researcher_translation_en: TR-YÖS: at least 400 points out of 500.
source_document: MADDE 7-(1)(a), Lisans Programları için Taban Puanlar
limitations: The associate-degree and special-talent threshold is different (300 out of 500) and is NOT this row. Do not apply this to two-year programmes.
researcher_notes: TR-YÖS SCALE FINDING, part 1 of 3. Hacettepe states the scale explicitly: 400 OUT OF 500. See REQ-9310 (Ankara, raw points with no scale stated) and REQ-9320 (METU, a PERCENTILE rather than a score). Three Turkish universities express thresholds on the same national exam three mutually non-comparable ways. The scale-qualifier problem documented for TOEFL is not an English-test problem; it is a test problem, and it is live in Turkey, ORYN's home market.

requirement_text: SAT I: "Evidence Based Reading and Writing" ve "Mathematics" puanları toplamı en az 1200 puan
researcher_translation_en: SAT I: the sum of the 'Evidence Based Reading and Writing' and 'Mathematics' scores must be at least 1200.
source_document: MADDE 7-(1)(b), Lisans Programları için Taban Puanlar
limitations: The directive names the two SAT sections by their pre-2024 titles ('Evidence Based Reading and Writing'), which College Board renamed to 'Reading and Writing' with the digital SAT. The threshold is the section SUM, so it is arithmetically unaffected, but a strict section-name match against a current score report will not find the named section. Same class of defect as an unqualified TOEFL scale, on a different test.
researcher_notes: Does not state whether superscores are accepted. Koc explicitly forbids them; Hacettepe is silent, which is an unknown rather than a permission.

requirement_text: GCE A Level: Ortalamanın en az C olması koşuluyla; başvurulan alanla ilgili derslerden en az 3 A Level ya da 2 A Level ve 1 AS Level (AS Level dersi A Level derslerinden farklı olmalıdır.)
researcher_translation_en: GCE A Level: provided the average is at least C; at least 3 A Levels in subjects related to the programme applied for, or 2 A Levels and 1 AS Level (the AS Level subject must be different from the A Level subjects).
source_document: MADDE 7-(1), Diploma / GCE A Level row
limitations: Recorded on the A-level letter scale as published. The parenthetical is a genuine constraint, not a clarification: an AS Level in the same subject as one of the A Levels does not count toward the three.
researcher_notes: Directly relevant to ORYN's Turkish students at British-curriculum schools in Istanbul and Ankara, who are the single most likely cohort to hold this qualification and apply to a Turkish university through the international quota.

requirement_text: Kabul edilen sınav türlerinin geçerlilik süresi, sınava giriş tarihinden itibaren iki yıldır. Lise diploma puanlarının geçerliliklerinde süre sınırı yoktur.
researcher_translation_en: The validity period of accepted exam types is two years from the date the exam was taken. There is no time limit on the validity of high school diploma scores.
source_document: MADDE 7-(2)
limitations: RECENCY RULE, anchored to the EXAM DATE rather than to course start - a fourth distinct anchor, and the first that is independent of when the student enrols. Per-qualification-type split again: two years for exams, unlimited for diplomas.
researcher_notes: Near-identical in substance to METU's REQ-9103 and Koc's rule. Three Turkish institutions independently converge on exam-2-years / diploma-unlimited, which suggests it descends from YÖK practice rather than being institutional choice - worth confirming against the YÖK Esaslar rows already in requirements_batch9.

requirement_text: Bu sınav/diploma türlerinin kontenjan içerisindeki yüzdelik ağırlığı TR-YÖS için %60, SAT için %30 ve GCE-A LEVEL için %10'dur.
researcher_translation_en: The percentage weight of these exam/diploma types within the quota is 60% for TR-YÖS, 30% for SAT and 10% for GCE A-Level.
source_document: MADDE 9-(1)
limitations: Not a threshold and not evaluable as one, which is exactly why it matters: it changes what meeting a threshold is WORTH. An A-level applicant who clears REQ-9304 competes for 10% of the places; a TR-YÖS applicant who clears REQ-9302 competes for 60%.
researcher_notes: The single most counselling-relevant fact found in this entire batch, and one no requirement-check UI would ever surface. ORYN's advisor is supposed to understand opportunity cost (spec section 2); telling a Turkish A-level student that Hacettepe reserves a tenth of its international quota for their qualification is precisely that kind of advice. MADDE 9-(5) adds that unfilled sub-quotas transfer to other types with TR-YÖS taking priority, so the effective A-level share can only shrink.

requirement_text: Eksik veya hatalı belge ile ya da belirlenen minimum puandan daha düşük puanla başvuranların başvuruları geçersiz sayılır.
researcher_translation_en: Applications submitted with missing or incorrect documents, or with a score lower than the specified minimum, are deemed invalid.
source_document: MADDE 6-(4)
researcher_notes: EXCLUSION. Establishes that Hacettepe's minima are hard floors, not guidance - unlike the UK 'typical offer', which is a target an admissions tutor may go below. A UK-shaped evaluator that treats every published grade as indicative would be wrong here in the direction that costs a student an application.

requirement_text: Başvuru tarihleri içinde henüz kesin sonucu açıklanmayan diploma notları (GCE A-LEVEL) ile başvurmak isteyen adaylar, okullarından onaylı tahmini sonuçlar ile başvurabilirler. Ancak bu şekilde başvuran adayların, bir programa yerleştirilmeleri halinde, başvurdukları puanları sağlamaları esastır. Bir programa yerleşen ancak kesinleşmiş puanları tahmini puanlarından düşük olan adaylar kayıt hakkını kaybetmiş sayılır.
researcher_translation_en: Candidates wishing to apply with diploma grades not yet finalised within the application dates (GCE A-LEVEL) may apply with predicted results certified by their school. However, if such candidates are placed on a programme, they must achieve the scores they applied with. Candidates placed on a programme whose final scores are lower than their predicted scores are deemed to have lost their right to register.
source_document: MADDE 6-(5)
limitations: A CONDITIONAL ACCEPTANCE, which a met/not_met evaluator has no state for. At application time a predicted grade satisfies the rule; at registration the same student can lose the place. The requirement's truth value depends on a future event.
researcher_notes: Note the asymmetry with UK practice: a UK offer is conditional on meeting the OFFER, so a student who is predicted A*AA and offered AAA is safe at AAA. At Hacettepe the student is held to their own PREDICTION, so over-prediction by a school is a live risk to the student rather than to the university. Worth surfacing to students at Turkish British-curriculum schools before they request predicted grades.

requirement_text: Liseyi Türkiye'de okumuş ve mavi kartlı olarak başvuru yapmak isteyen adayların başvuru tarihleri içinde mavi kart veya vatandaşlıktan çıkma belgesi almış olmaları gerekmektedir. Vatandaşlıktan çıkma başvurusunu yapmış, işlemleri devam eden, ancak başvuru tarihlerinde henüz Türk vatandaşlığından çıkmamış adayların, başvuruları geçersiz sayılır
researcher_translation_en: Candidates who attended high school in Türkiye and wish to apply as blue card holders must have obtained the blue card or the certificate of renunciation of citizenship within the application dates. Applications from candidates who have applied to renounce citizenship, whose proceedings are ongoing, but who have not yet renounced Turkish citizenship by the application dates, are deemed invalid.
source_document: MADDE 6-(6)
limitations: EXCLUSION WITH A TIMING CONDITION - eligibility turns on the STATE OF A GOVERNMENT PROCESS on a specific date, not on any attribute of the student's academic record. Nothing ORYN stores about a student can evaluate this.
researcher_notes: The blue-card route is one of the YÖK categories captured verbatim at REQ-2026-08-21-8002 in requirements_batch9. This is Hacettepe adding a procedural cut-off on top of the national rule: an in-progress renunciation is not enough. Exactly the 'exceptions nested two deep' pattern the brief warned about, and it disqualifies a student who would read the YÖK rule alone as qualifying.

requirement_text: Eğitim dili tamamen veya kısmen yabancı dilde olan programlara başvuran adaylardan başvuru aşamasında bu dillere ait dil yeterlik belgesi istenmez. Ancak kayıt hakkı elde eden adayların kayıt aşamasında bu dillerde yeterliklerini gösterir şekilde, Yabancı Diller Yüksekokulu internet sayfasında listeleri yayınlanan, Hacettepe Üniversitesi tarafından eşdeğerliği kabul edilen ulusal/uluslararası sınavlara ait sonuçlarını ibraz etmesi gereklidir.
researcher_translation_en: Candidates applying to programmes taught wholly or partly in a foreign language are not asked for a language proficiency certificate at the application stage. However, candidates who gain the right to register must, at registration, present results from national/international exams whose equivalence is accepted by Hacettepe University, listed on the School of Foreign Languages website.
source_document: MADDE 12-(1)
limitations: The language requirement binds at REGISTRATION, not application, and failure routes the student into a preparatory year rather than rejecting them. A met/not_met evaluation is wrong in both directions: not_met at application overstates the barrier, met understates the prep-year cost.
researcher_notes: Same structure as ITU's REQ-9114. Two of ORYN's largest Turkish target institutions defer the language requirement past the application, which means an English score is NOT an application blocker in Turkey the way it is in the UK. A single 'English proficiency' requirement row shown identically for a UK and a Turkish target would mislead about both.

program_name: Medicine; Medicine (English); Dentistry; Dentistry (English); Computer Engineering; Computer Engineering (English); Electrical-Electronics Engineering (English); Artificial Intelligence and Data Engineering; Software Engineering
requirement_text: Minimum 440 points from TR-YÖS
source_document: VALID EXAMINATIONS AND REQUIRED SCORES (English edition), page 1
limitations: NO SCALE STATED. The table gives '440 points' with no denominator anywhere on either page. Hacettepe's directive establishes TR-YÖS as a 500-point exam (REQ-9302), so 440/500 is the overwhelmingly likely reading - but it is an inference, not the source's statement, and this lane does not promote inferences to facts. Stored as TR_YOS_SCALE_UNSTATED so no evaluator silently assumes a denominator.
researcher_notes: TR-YÖS SCALE FINDING, part 2 of 3. Note also that this page is dated 2026/07 in its own URL path, making it the freshest Turkish source in the corpus - freshness and scale-clarity are independent properties, and this row has one without the other.

program_name: Medicine; Dentistry; Computer Engineering; Electrical-Electronics Engineering; Artificial Intelligence and Data Engineering; Software Engineering; Pharmacy; Biomedical Engineering; Civil Engineering; Nursing; Midwifery; Law; Veterinary; Physics Engineering; Food Engineering; Geophysical Engineering; Geological Engineering; Chemical Engineering
requirement_text: VALID EXAMINATIONS AND REQUIRED SCORES FOR PROGRAMMES EXCLUDING THE ABOVE-LISTED
source_document: VALID EXAMINATIONS AND REQUIRED SCORES (English edition), page 2 heading
limitations: STRUCTURAL EXCLUSION, and the highest-stakes row in this batch. Page 1 lists these named programmes with TR-YÖS thresholds only. Page 2 opens the multi-exam table (SAT, IB, A-Level, Abitur, WASSCE, ORT, TQDK, high school diploma) with this heading, which EXCLUDES the page-1 programmes from all of it. Consequence: an international applicant to Ankara Medicine, Dentistry, Computer Engineering, AI and Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Law, Veterinary or Pharmacy cannot use SAT, IB or A-Levels at all. Only TR-YÖS.
researcher_notes: This is a requirement that exists only as the ABSENCE of a row plus a heading, which is precisely the shape a positive-thresholds-only store cannot hold. A student with SAT 1500 aiming at Ankara Computer Engineering has no failing row to match against; the correct answer is not_met, and a naive store would return unknown or, worse, match them against the page-2 SAT row and return met. Recorded as an explicit exclusion so the rule survives ingestion.

program_name: Pharmacy; Pharmacy (English); Biomedical Engineering (English); Civil Engineering
requirement_text: Minimum 400 points from TR-YÖS
source_document: VALID EXAMINATIONS AND REQUIRED SCORES (English edition), page 1
limitations: No scale stated (see REQ-9320). Additionally the page-1 table's row boundaries do not survive text extraction cleanly - 'Pharmacy' and 'Civil Engineering' sit adjacent to the 400-point and 300-point cells in a way that could belong to either. Confirm the exact programme-to-threshold mapping against the rendered PDF before ingesting. The 400-point figure itself is certain; its programme list is not.
researcher_notes: Recorded with the mapping flagged rather than guessed. A wrong mapping here tells a Pharmacy applicant they qualify at 300.

requirement_text: TR-YÖS Minimum 200 points Valid for 2 years from the exam date.
source_document: VALID EXAMINATIONS AND REQUIRED SCORES (English edition), page 2
limitations: Applies ONLY to programmes not listed on page 1 - see REQ-9321. No scale stated. Carries its own 2-year recency rule anchored to the exam date.
researcher_notes: The spread within one institution is 200 to 440 on the same exam, i.e. the threshold more than doubles between the general pool and Medicine. A single per-university TR-YÖS number would be wrong for almost every Ankara programme.

requirement_text: SAT "Scholastic Assessment Test" Minimum 1100 in total and minimum 650 in Math. The Math score is used in evaluation/placement. Valid for 2 years from the exam date.
source_document: VALID EXAMINATIONS AND REQUIRED SCORES (English edition), page 2
limitations: Applies ONLY to programmes not listed on page 1 (REQ-9321) - in particular NOT to Computer Engineering, AI and Data Engineering or Software Engineering, which are the programmes a high-SAT-Math applicant would most want. Total is on the 400-1600 scale by construction (1100 total with 650 Math).
researcher_notes: Two-part threshold: an overall AND a section floor, plus a statement that the Math section drives placement rather than merely gating it. A single scalar cannot carry any of the three.

requirement_text: International Baccalaureate (IB) Minimum 30 points
source_document: VALID EXAMINATIONS AND REQUIRED SCORES (English edition), page 2
limitations: Applies ONLY to programmes not listed on page 1 (REQ-9321).
researcher_notes: IB scale, no conversion. Ankara sets 30 where METU sets 33 and Manchester CS sets 37 - the same qualification read three ways, which is the argument for storing the requirement rather than a derived 'IB strength' number.

requirement_text: General High School Diploma Graduation GPA of at least 80 out of 100 (Excluding high school diplomas obtained from schools located in Türkiye.) The general high school diploma is used to evaluate quotas that remain vacant after placement based on exam results.
source_document: VALID EXAMINATIONS AND REQUIRED SCORES (English edition), page 2
limitations: Carries an embedded EXCLUSION (schools located in Türkiye) and a RANKING DEMOTION (used only for quotas left vacant after exam-based placement) inside one cell. is_exclusion is set true because the parenthetical disqualifies a class of applicant outright; the demotion is captured in the text and cannot be expressed as a threshold at all.
researcher_notes: GPA is 80 OUT OF 100, the Turkish scale, recorded as published. This must never be converted to a US 4.0 by ratio - ORYN's own code refuses that conversion and this row must not tempt it. The demotion is the counselling-relevant half: a student relying on their diploma is not competing on equal terms with an exam-holder, they are competing for leftovers.

requirement_text: TR-YÖS: Having ranked in the first 5th percentile in the TR-YÖS exam taken by the applicant.
source_document: METU ANKARA CAMPUS UNDERGRADUATE PROGRAMS - INTERNATIONAL STUDENT MINIMUM APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS (Last update: 05/01/2024)
limitations: TR-YÖS SCALE FINDING, part 3 of 3, and the sharpest. METU sets no score at all - it sets a PERCENTILE RANK, which cannot be evaluated from a stored score without that year's national distribution, a fact ORYN does not hold and cannot derive. A student who knows their TR-YÖS score cannot self-assess against METU.
researcher_notes: Put the three together: Hacettepe 400/500, Ankara '440 points' with no denominator, METU top 5th percentile. Same national exam, same country, same admission cycle, three incompatible expressions - one absolute with a scale, one absolute without, one relative. No single numeric column can hold all three, and a comparison across the three is meaningless. This is the Turkish counterpart of the TOEFL rescale finding and it needs the same fix: the scale travels with the threshold, and a relative threshold is a different kind of thing from an absolute one.

requirement_text: SAT I: A minimum total score of 1200 (with an additional minimum "Math" score of 700 out of 800 for the Faculty of Engineering, Faculty of Architecture, and scientific programs offered by the Faculty of Arts and Sciences)
source_document: METU ANKARA CAMPUS UNDERGRADUATE PROGRAMS - INTERNATIONAL STUDENT MINIMUM APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS (Last update: 05/01/2024)
limitations: Document's own last-update stamp is 05/01/2024, and it is the file METU's live application-requirements page links to as current. Fresh enough to be authoritative for METU's published position; old enough that a re-check before the next cycle is warranted. Note the conditional section floor: 700/800 Math applies only to Engineering, Architecture and the science programmes of Arts and Sciences.
researcher_notes: Compare Hacettepe's SAT 1200 (REQ-9303) and Ankara's 1100+650 Math (REQ-9324). METU is the strictest on Math for technical faculties at 700, and unlike Ankara it applies the section floor conditionally by faculty rather than universally.

requirement_text: International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma: An International Baccalaureate Diploma with a min. total score of 33 (at least one High Level-HL course relevant to the program applied for should be taken.)
source_document: METU ANKARA CAMPUS UNDERGRADUATE PROGRAMS - INTERNATIONAL STUDENT MINIMUM APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS (Last update: 05/01/2024)
limitations: The relevance condition on the HL course is programme-dependent and cannot be evaluated without a subject-to-programme relevance mapping that ORYN does not hold.
researcher_notes: IB scale, no conversion. Requires the full DIPLOMA, so IB Certificate holders are outside this route entirely - an exclusion by omission rather than by statement.

requirement_text: International A Levels: A minimum grade of ABB in three A-level subjects, two of which are relevant to the program applied for. (Language subjects other than English cannot be used for application.)
source_document: METU ANKARA CAMPUS UNDERGRADUATE PROGRAMS - INTERNATIONAL STUDENT MINIMUM APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS (Last update: 05/01/2024)
limitations: Contains an embedded EXCLUSION: A-levels in languages other than English do not count toward the three. is_exclusion set true because the parenthetical removes qualifications a student genuinely holds from the count.
researcher_notes: Bites hardest on exactly ORYN's core Turkish cohort: a Turkish student at a British-curriculum school holding A-levels in, say, Turkish and French finds two of their three subjects inadmissible. A store holding only 'ABB in three A-levels' answers met for that student.

requirement_text: Advanced Placement Test (AP): A minimum grade of 4 in each of at least four Advanced Placement subjects. (Calculus AB or BC is required for the Faculty of Engineering, Faculty of Architecture, and scientific programs offered by the Faculty of Arts and Sciences.)
source_document: METU ANKARA CAMPUS UNDERGRADUATE PROGRAMS - INTERNATIONAL STUDENT MINIMUM APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS (Last update: 05/01/2024)
limitations: Requires FOUR subjects at 4+, each individually - not an average and not a total. A student with three 5s and one 3 fails.
researcher_notes: AP 1-5 scale, no conversion. One of very few places in this corpus where AP is a primary entry qualification rather than advanced standing, which makes METU a genuine target for a Turkish student on a US-curriculum school track.

requirement_text: Having achieved a minimum of 90% success in a high school graduation certificate referred to as a Baccalaureate/High School Graduation Certificate/Matura/General Secondary Education Certificate, provided that this certificate allows transition to a 4-year undergraduate program.
source_document: METU ANKARA CAMPUS UNDERGRADUATE PROGRAMS - INTERNATIONAL STUDENT MINIMUM APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS, Country Category-C
limitations: COUNTRY-CONDITIONAL THRESHOLD. METU sets 90% for Category-C countries and 80% for Category-B countries for the same kind of document. The applicable number depends on the student's country of qualification, so this rule cannot be evaluated from a grade alone. METU's own footnote states the categorisation 'does not imply priority for any specific country' and exists to simplify presentation.
researcher_notes: The first requirement in this corpus whose threshold is a function of nationality/country of qualification. ORYN stores country, so this is evaluable in principle, but only if the country-to-category mapping is stored as data rather than folded into a single number. Category-C as printed includes Bahrain, Bangladesh, UAE, Burundi, Ethiopia, Iraq, Iran, Qatar, DR Congo, Kuwait, Libya, Egypt, Uzbekistan, Pakistan, Somalia, Sudan, Syria, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Oman, Jordan, Yemen and 'Other Countries'.

requirement_text: High school diplomas awarded in Türkiye and the TRNC through national high school curriculums will not be covered in Category C, Other Countries.
source_document: METU ANKARA CAMPUS UNDERGRADUATE PROGRAMS - INTERNATIONAL STUDENT MINIMUM APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS, footnote **
limitations: EXCLUSION LIVING IN A FOOTNOTE. It closes the catch-all: a student cannot route a Turkish or TRNC national-curriculum diploma through 'Other Countries' to reach the Category-C percentage rule. The same footnote also excludes Category-A countries from Category-C, and excludes diplomas from Ghana, Nigeria, Liberia, Gambia and Sierra Leone (which have their own WAEC route).
researcher_notes: Footnotes are where the exclusions hide. This one is invisible to any extraction that reads the tables and stops. It is also the rule that keeps the international quota from being used by domestically-educated students, which is the same policy intent as the YÖK clauses at REQ-8001 in requirements_batch9 - a national rule and an institutional footnote enforcing the same boundary by different means.
